files.name: Barnacle
files.description: Nobody expects the lowly barnacle

files.name: Bocakillo
files.description: A tiny plastitanium vessel suited to a crew of 2 to 3 pirates. Has two broadside cannons and a rear-facing disposals launcher. Runs on plasma.

files.name: Falcon
files.description: Rebuilt mining vessel made into a pirate ship with hangar bay to store vehicles, fits between 3-4 crew.

files.name: Menace
files.description: Mail is no longer an option: you either receive it or you die.

files.name: Schooner
files.description: A small wooden ship with 2 central cargo bays.

files.name: Turncoat
files.description: A mercenaries pride and joy, repurposed at illicit shipyards for nefarious ends. Suited to a crew of 4.

files.name: FSA Aegis
files.description: The Aegis is an expedition shuttle designed for long duration exploration missions with the comfort and care of the crew as a mainstay priority.

files.name: KC Anchor
files.description: A large luxury cruiser capable of long ranged travel acrossed the sector, expedition capable.

files.name: LVHI Brigand
files.description: Civilian conversion of an old military light frigate from the early days of humanity's expansion to the stars, predating FTL technology. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: EIS Charon
files.description: Originally built as a roll-on, roll-off transport for heavy terraforming equipment. Since its obsolescence and appearance on the secondary market, the Charon has become a favorite of upfitters for the broad possibilities afforded by its open equipment bay. A product of Endurance Industrial Shipyards.

files.name: DYS Dove
files.description: Versatile expedition-capable multi-purpose light freighter.

files.name: DYS Dragonfly
files.description: Highly modular salvaging vessel welded together from smaller re-purposed hulls.

files.name: KC Pathfinder
files.description: Once a scout ship serving with the Nanotrasen Marine Expeditionary Forces, this now decommissioned expedition capable ship can be yours!

files.name: KC Sprinter
files.description: A light freighter often picked by bounty hunters due to its quick acceleration, expedition capable.

files.name: NSF Broadhead
files.description: A medium size detective ship with facilities for autopsies, interrogations and detailed investigations.

files.name: NSF Empress
files.description: A large patrol vessel capable of carrying up to 4 smaller faster attack ships. The flagship vessel of the NFSD.

files.name: NSF Heimdall
files.description: A small detective runabout for intelligence gathering and forensic work.

files.name: NSF Hospitaller
files.description: A small security medical craft designed for emergency response and search and rescue operations.

files.name: NSF Hypnos
files.description: A light medium ship with a recommended crew of 2 to 3 officers, the Hypnos is a dedicated interdiction vessel outfitted with a powerful EMP device for tackling escaping vessels.

files.name: NSF Paladin
files.description: A small security assault craft designed for space combat equipped with an EXP-2100g mounted grenade launcher.

files.name: NSF Prowler
files.description: A medium-sized patrol craft, the Prowler class is a dedicated deep space pursuit vessel with an advanced sensor suite and moderate cargo capacity.

files.name: NSF Templar
files.description: A small security assault craft designed for combat interdiction operations.

files.name: NSF Wasp
files.description: A large expedition oriented ship for holding prisoners and making them work planetside.

files.name: NSF Cleric
files.description: Micro support vessel used for emergency rescues and first aid.

files.name: NSF Fighter
files.description: Micro attack vessel used for boarding and transport of prisoners.

files.name: NSF Rogue
files.description: Micro assault vessel with a toggle for going dark in deep space.

files.name: DC McDelivery
files.description: Fast food fast ship, bring the McCargo meals to the people

files.name: UAC Canister
files.description: Whatever you're bringing, it won't fit. Seats two. Gravity included.

files.name: NT Construct
files.description: A technically spacefaring vessel.  No livery.

files.name: NSV Disciple
files.description: A cheaply made amalgamation of religious ships. For the seasoned religious assistant.

files.name: CLU Geode
files.description: Built into a rock by the finest goblin engineers, this vessel has all the discrete trader needs to conduct business.

files.name: SV Nugget
files.description: A flying hunk of wood and metal disguised as a kitchen shuttle. Not FDA approved.

files.name: SV Orange
files.description: A cargo slash salvage shuttle made from scavenged wrecks, comes with some damage.

files.name: SSF Rusty
files.description: A cheap old model transport shuttle, good enough to get to places.

files.name: SV Tide
files.description: A cheaply made mass-produced shuttle made from salvaged wrecks. For the seasoned assistant.

files.name: LVHI Broom
files.description: A cramped yet reliable shuttle for providing official janitorial services. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: NC Chauffeur
files.description: A small transport shuttle with space for 4 passengers. Comes with the latest audio entertainment technology.

files.name: NT Duchess
files.description: A mobile office and personal transport for the Station Representative, based on the BB Bodkin.

files.name: FSC Express
files.description: A small endurance shuttle for express logistics support in Frontier space.

files.name: LVHI Harbormaster
files.description: A small tugboat. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: CBC Hound
files.description: A Rotund Security vessel capable of housing and transporting the roudiest of criminals!

files.name: NC Mail Pod
files.description: A cramped yet reliable shuttle for delivering packages.

files.name: NC Parcel
files.description: A reliable shuttle for delivering mail and packages.

files.name: Hunter
files.description: A small armored Syndicate assault shuttle, perfect for devious operations!

files.name: Infiltrator
files.description: A Syndicate nuclear operative infiltration ship.

files.name: Voltage
files.description: A small armored Syndicate smuggling shuttle, perfect for fueling Nanotrasen's inevitable demise!

files.name: LVHI Adder
files.description: A small maneuverable shuttle designed for mining. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: UAC Ambition
files.description: Declassified gas production and distribution platform seized in a hostile takeover of an Atmosian conglomerate. For the ultimate insurgent.

files.name: NT Backpacker
files.description: A small recreational shuttle for all your out in space adventure. Comes fully kitted with a small kitchen, toilet, work garage and highly customizable recreational spaces.

files.name: PT Balena
files.description: A full service super-yacht with a bar, concession booth, and swimming pool for the most affluent of travelers.

files.name: NC Barge
files.description: A medium shipping vessel repurposed in a salvage and material exploitation vessel.

files.name: BB Baroness
files.description: A small luxury cruiser for one or two people, with a lounge, a private bedroom, and a hell of a cockpit view.

files.name: NC Bocadillo
files.description: A tiny food truck perfect for a solo chef. Better with a friend!

files.name: BB Bodkin
files.description: The smaller sibling to the Broadhead, the BB Bodkin is designed for rockhopping and salvage recovery.

files.name: BB Bookworm
files.description: A cozy medium-size library for travellers who wish to relax with a book or perhaps a board game.

files.name: KL Bulker
files.description: A medium mining vessel designed for deep space missions

files.name: SSF Camper
files.description: A personal mobile home for nomadic spacers, equipped with a small kitchen, toilet and bedroom.

files.name: BB Ceres
files.description: A medium-size, high-class restaurant ship with ample seating, integrated botany and a dining room for VIP guests

files.name: ICR Chisel
files.description: Standard small-size vessel, originally meant to aid in ship scrapping, now modified to function as a multipurpose salvage/mining/cargo-hauling shuttle.

files.name: SSF Coffeehouse
files.description: A small service ship with café inside it, ready to serve the best coffee in the galaxy.

files.name: NT Comet
files.description: A mining and construction vessel intended to help build or repair quickly.

files.name: LVHI Copperhead
files.description: Copperhead is an affordable, versatile, small shuttle with room for customization optimized for mining and salvage missions. Whether operating within a fleet or autonomously, its design is a compromise between speed, which is important for medium- to long-distance travel, and maneuverability, which is crucial for navigating asteroid fields. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: FSC Courier
files.description: A nimble cargo runner designed to move high value cargo as safely as the pilot is willing through the hazardous pockets of deep space.

files.name: NC Crescent
files.description: The Crescent, named for its exterior shape, is a vessel focused on providing service, medical aide, and scientific breakthroughs for smaller vessels.

files.name: PHI Crossroads
files.description: A spacious and inviting service ship. The crossroads is designed to help with dock crowding, connect communities, and serve as anchors for gatherings.

files.name: FSA Dragoon
files.description: The Dragoon is the explorer of choice for adventures that are more guns and explosives themed.

files.name: AC Firefighter
files.description: An engineering vessel designed for rapid repairs and delivering relief from searing shuttle fires.

files.name: HS Garden
files.description: A small botany vessel dedicated to horiticultural experimentation.

files.name: LVHI Gasbender
files.description: The Gasbender is a medium-sized engineering vessel outfitted for deep space construction projects. Features atmospherics setup with mixing/ignition chamber. Designed to work in pair with smaller salvage ship. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: FSC Gaslight
files.description: A compact gas extraction and mining vessel designed and deployed by the Far Star Corporation.

files.name: BB Hammer
files.description: A mobile engineering platform for deep-space repairs, upgrades and remodelling.

files.name: NC Hauler
files.description: A medium sized vessel specializing in long-haul salvage, mining, and cargo operations.

files.name: NT Honker
files.description: HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK

files.name: NR Investigator
files.description: A medium research shuttle designed for xenoarcheological studies.

files.name: SSF Izakaya
files.description: A medium-size, japanese-inspired restaurant/pub ship with a large dining area, and equally large kitchen.

files.name: PT Jackrabbit
files.description: A fast and lightweight cruiser for those with criminal records a little too long to be cops.

files.name: NC Kestrel
files.description: Once a local shipping lane freighter, this model has been converted for use in debris field mining and salvage operations.

files.name: LVHI Kilderkin
files.description: Spaceworthy bar/microbrewery with everything one needs to facilitate poor life choices: lots of booze, smokes, and lack of food. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: LVHI Lantern Mk2
files.description: The Lantern Mk2 is a small-sized modification of and old chapel-vessel design equipped with everything chaplain might need in their never ending battle for salvation of NT personnel souls. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: LVHI Liquidator
files.description: A small shipbreaker/salvage vessel equipped with everything a small crew need for extended work shift in deep space. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: NC Loader
files.description: A compact cargo ship designed for hauling shipments.

files.name: BB Lyrae
files.description: A medium size science vessel with laboratories for both anomalous and xenoarchaeology research.

files.name: DC McCargo
files.description: Your very own McCargo™ franchise! Comes fully stocked and ready for production of McMeals.

files.name: FSC Nightlight
files.description: The Far Star Corporation's premier catering and service shuttle! Legally NOT a testbed for nutrient sequencing and biogenerative pattern research on humanoid physiology!

files.name: WSE Nook
files.description: A ship designed as a mobile home, with space for user modifications. Fast and comfortable.

files.name: NR Phoenix
files.description: A research and salvage vessel designed for deep space exploration.

files.name: NC Piecrust
files.description: A rustic cafe for the nostalgic deep space chef.

files.name: NC Placebo
files.description: A small psychology vessel. Named after the famous Placebo effect.

files.name: NC Prospector
files.description: A small mining vessel designed to assist salvage operations.

files.name: NC Personal Transport
files.description: A small transport shuttle with space for 4 passengers. Comes with the latest audio entertainment technology.

files.name: FSC Pulsar
files.description: The Pulsar offers two robust polar work sites built around object retrieval and research circling a command hub. With a focus on safety, know that any catastrophic failures are entirely the fault of the operator! Brought to you by the Far Star Corporation.

files.name: FSC Retort
files.description: A robust gas mining and engineering vessel designed and deployed by the Far Star Corporation to provide infrastructure support for deep space operations.

files.name: NC Skipper
files.description: A small service ship with a full service kitchen and hydroponics garden.

files.name: NR Spectre
files.description: A large, robust vessel with a pure focus on research and development. It is equipped with multiple artifact chambers.

files.name: NT Stellaris
files.description: A mobile theatre perfect for putting on any show.

files.name: LVHI Stringer
files.description: A small shuttle with low operational costs for reporters who want to be first on a scene. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: DBI Stronghold
files.description: A science Vessel with a Robust Research chamber.

files.name: FSC Surveyor
files.description: A budget mining and recovery shuttle for corporations unwilling to operate outside of a shoestring budget. Brought to you by the Far Star Corporation!

files.name: NT Vagabond
files.description: A adaptable long-haul industrial freighter that pilots have adapted to many different purposes.

files.name: UW Akupara
files.description: A medium full-feature botanical research biodome equipped to help a botanist fully interact with their plants in almost any way conceivable.

files.name: FSB Apothecary
files.description: A small medical and chemistry support vessel. Deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to provide aid and medical services to the Frontier.

files.name: FSB Caladrius
files.description: A medical carrier produced by the Far Star Biotech corporation. Designed for large scale colonization support, humanitarian relief and post-disaster investigation and recovery operations.

files.name: FSB Druid
files.description: A medium service vessel providing botanical and chemical services to support the needs of the Frontier. Designed, developed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to render aid wherever it is needed.

files.name: NM Eagle
files.description: A medium-sized engineering and medical vessel. Focused on responding to shuttle distress, the Eagle comes equipped to restore most crew and shuttles to good health.

files.name: LVHI Searchlight
files.description: A small vessel outfitted for the search and recovery of wounded NT personnel. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

files.name: FSB Spirit
files.description: The FSB Spirit is a search and rescue shuttle for experienced Frontier medics.

files.name: FSB Stasis
files.description: A medium medical vessel providing cryogenic and support medical services for the traumas of deep space operations. Designed, developed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to render aid wherever it is needed.

files.name: BB Tyne
files.description: A small, agile lifeboat with an exterior deck and survivor cabin for search and rescue operations.

files.name: CTC Vitalis
files.description: A medium medical support vessel designed for cryogenic deployment.
